messages:
tess: quick heads-up from onboarding — several sample repos use three different env names: REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY, and SERVICE_TOKEN. people are getting flaky auth failures depending on shell/profile setup.

omar: gah. that's rough for first-run DX. do we have a single canonical name anywhere?

lyn: historically we've been inconsistent. i vote we standardize on a clear name that signals "machine/service credential" vs user oauth. proposal: REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY as canonical. keep REDWOOD_API_KEY as alias for compatibility. retire SERVICE_TOKEN.

tess: i like that. can we also make the precedence explicit in our SDK init code? e.g. env lookup order: REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY -> RW_LEGACY_TOKEN. and emit a warning if RW_LEGACY_TOKEN or SERVICE_TOKEN used.

omar: +1 on aliasing and warning. also observed that when SDK sees a 401 it retries multiple times with exponential backoff before surfacing anything. that eats user time and obscures the real problem (bad key). i'd prefer 401 to be fast-fail with a helpful error hint about rotation.

lyn: agree. implementation idea: no automatic retry on 401, emit an event `auth:invalid` with details (env var used, masked token prefix) and return error code `AUTH_INVALID_KEY`. retries should still happen for 5xx or network errors.

bot-cred: flagged usage: samples/node/getting-started.js uses SERVICE_TOKEN. recommended fix: switch to REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY and add a comment about `rw keys rotate --local`.

dev-oncall: for the rotation UX, can we add a tiny helper in the CLI and SDK docs. example snippet for onboarding page: 
```bash
# rotate locally and update env (bash)
rw keys rotate --local --output env > ~/.redwood/temp_env && source ~/.redwood/temp_env
# or using jq to extract
export REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY=$(rw keys rotate --local --json | jq -r '.key')
```

tess: perfect. i'll update onboarding dojo and the getting-started. also will add a one-line warning in the SDK logs when falling back to aliases.

omar: i'll take the SDK patch. plan: add `envPrecedence` helper, warning log, and change auth retry policy: 401 => throw `AUTH_INVALID_KEY`, emit `auth:invalid` event. i'll gate behavioral change behind an opt-in init flag `strictAuth: true` for the next minor to avoid surprises, and switch the default after a short stabilization window.

lyn: please also add unit tests that simulate invalid credentials and assert no retry attempts are made (mock clock + fake transport). plus an integration test that ensures the CLI rotate snippet actually injects the new key into the sampled environment.

tess: opened meta-issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev/issues/4187 mapped tasks: samples cleanup, CLI helper docs, SDK change (omar), onboarding updates (tess).

dev-oncall: going to add a tiny cred-lint rule to fail PRs that add SERVICE_TOKEN or RW_LEGACY_TOKEN new usages. we can run an autofix in the samples PR.

omar: i'll ping here when the SDK branch is ready for review. thanks team — should make onboarding a lot smoother. :rocket:
